answer: Miscellaneous >> Dua (Supplications) Question ID: 152397 Country: India Title: A person had said to me reciting surah Rahman 11 times and make dua and dua will comes true or accepted. Is it true? Question: A person had said to me reciting surah Rahman 11 times and make dua and dua will comes true or accepted. Is it true? Answer ID: 152397 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1098/1033/B=11/1438) We could not find such things in Hadith. However if you supplicate after reciting any part of the Holy Quran then your prayer shall be answered, in-shaAllah. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
